translations: and never will deprive you (of) your deeds
puzzle.hint: A powerful call to steadfastness for believers — never lose heart or despair, for the ultimate victory belongs to those who have true faith.
puzzle.arabic: فَلَا تَهِنُوا۟ وَتَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّلْمِ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَوْنَ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَكُمْ وَلَن يَتِرَكُمْ أَعْمَـٰلَكُمْ
puzzle.verseEn: So do not weaken and call for peace while you are superior; and Allāh is with you and will never deprive you of [the reward of] your deeds.
